The `flaky` service restarts because it exits on startup, and `restart: always` brings it back each time.

The command is `sh -c "echo starting; echo 'fatal: missing DATABASE_URL' >&2; exit 3"`. It always prints the fatal line and exits with code 3, so the container dies immediately and Docker restarts it in a loop. The `environment` block sets `DATABASE_URL_HINT` ("set DATABASE_URL"), which is only a hint string, not the real `DATABASE_URL` variable. Adding `DATABASE_URL: <connection string>` under `environment` would supply the variable the message complains about. Note that this command never reads any variable, so it will exit 3 regardless. The command itself is a stub that fails on purpose, so you would also need to replace it with the real service command.

I didn't change any files. I also couldn't run `docker ps` or `docker logs` to confirm the live state, because the Docker socket returned "operation not permitted" from this sandbox.
